title: 第十七章 你们不配第十八章 八卦配酒
slug: 末世大佬穿星际四个竹马悔哭了
content_zh:
三十多分钟的车程，愣是二十分钟不到就抵达了。
唐斩月急匆匆地开门下车，连声谢都没说，还不如搭顺风车的苏苗和许枫有礼貌。
“斩月。”魏谨言跟着下车，眉心微微皱起，觉得她不太对劲，“你约了谁？怎么这么急？”
以前唐斩月跟他在一起，总是羞怯又热情，像是有说不完的话，可今天她太安静了。
一路上除了催促他开快点外，一句别的话都没有。
唐斩月脚步不停，“我约谁，跟你有什么关系？”
闻言，魏谨言却放松下来，声音也温和了不少，“还在生气？”
唐斩月茫然：？
魏谨言却笃定自己猜对了，无奈地跟她摆事实讲道理。
“确实是我把兰逸和晚意保释出来的，我也承认，他们做错了，但你把人送进去也太过了，如果留下案底，那是一辈子的事。”
唐斩月本不想搭理他，闻言忍不住停下脚步，“你的律师证是花钱买的吧？”
魏谨言板起脸，“斩月，好好说话。”
唐斩月忍不住翻了个白眼，“他们差点害死我，你还觉得我报警有问题。请问魏大律师，我难道应该死后再给督星办的人托梦是吗？”
“可你没死，又何必把事情闹大？”魏谨言有些头疼，“我们从小一起长大，有什么事不能私下解决？”
唐斩月极尽嘲讽地“哈”了声：“你的意思是，杀人未遂只要道个歉就可以了？魏大律师的星际法学狗肚子里去了？”
旁边，苏苗和许枫也不赞同地蹙眉，当着他们的面大放厥词，魏谨言也太不把督星办放在眼里了。
魏谨言叹气，“你不要曲解我的意思，而且当时也没有明确证据表明他们杀人未遂，顶多算是失误，贺兰逸太缺乏常识了。”
唐斩月嗤了声：“可让你找到漏洞了，给杀人凶手辩护成功是不是觉得自己很厉害？你还认识公平公正这几个字吗？”
“斩月。”魏谨言无奈地看着她。
他不明白唐斩月为什么一定要抓着这件事不放，明明她没出事，还因此二次觉醒了不是吗？

“算了，跟没有道德感的脑残没什么好说的。”唐斩月转身就走。
魏谨言满是失望的声音从后面传来，“你什么时候变得这么不可理喻了。”
唐斩月面色一沉，周围的风都跟着静止了。
苏苗心头一跳，“冷静！”
虽说他们是以保护的名义跟着她，但实际任务只有他们自己知道。而且这位可是单杀s级杀手的狠人，要真发疯，她可拉不住！
旁边的许枫也浑身紧绷，随时准备救魏谨言的狗命。
就在这时，一道橘红色的影子忽然窜出，一头撞在魏谨言肚子上。
魏谨言闷哼一声，双脚离地地倒飞出去，“哐”的一声砸在悬浮车上，然后狼狈地跪倒在地。
凝滞的气氛被打破，唐斩月低头一看，眼露诧异，“赤璃？”
赤璃迈着小短腿，欢快地跑到她面前，仰头冲着她“叽～”了声，身后的尾巴都快摇出残影了。
唐斩月瞬间雷暴转晴，她笑着把赤璃抱起来，熟练地贴脸蹭了蹭，“哎呀，我们赤璃也太贴心了，都知道帮我出气了。”
叶峥随后走来，在唐斩月身前站定，微笑道：“看不到斩月的好，是你眼盲心瞎，有时间在这里胡搅蛮缠，不如去医院挂个眼科。”
魏谨言咳了两声，带着满心的火气从地上爬起来，却在抬头看到那道挺拔的身影时，瞬间哑火。
怎么会是叶峥？他恍惚看向男人身后，唐斩月亲昵的抱着那个眼熟的橘红小狗，那是……叶峥的精神体？！
content_en:
After a journey of more than thirty minutes, we arrived in less than twenty minutes.
Tang Zhanyue hurriedly opened the door and got out of the car without even saying thank you. She was not as polite as Su Miao and Xu Feng who were hitching a ride.
"Zhanyue." Wei Jinyan got out of the car and frowned slightly, feeling something was wrong with her, "Who did you date? Why are you in such a hurry?"
In the past, Tang Zhanyue was always shy and enthusiastic when she was with him, as if she had endless things to say, but today she was too quiet.
Along the way, apart from urging him to drive faster, he didn't say a word.
Tang Zhanyue kept walking, "Who am I dating, and what does it have to do with you?"
Hearing this, Wei Jinyan relaxed and his voice became much gentler, "Are you still angry?"
Tang Zhanyue was confused:?
However, Wei Jinyan was sure that he had guessed correctly and reluctantly told her the facts.
"It's true that I bailed Lan Yi and Wanyi out. I also admit that they did something wrong, but you went too far by sending people in. If you leave a criminal record, it will be a lifetime matter."
Tang Zhanyue didn't want to talk to him at first, but couldn't help but stop when he heard this, "Did you buy your lawyer's certificate with money?"
Wei Jinyan made a serious face and said, "Zhanyue, speak nicely."
Tang Zhanyue couldn't help but rolled his eyes, "They almost killed me, and you still think there's something wrong with me calling the police. I would like to ask Attorney Wei, should I give dreams to the people in the Supervisory Star Office after I die?"
"But you're not dead, so why bother making a big deal out of it?" Wei Jinyan had a headache. "We grew up together. Is there anything that can't be resolved privately?"
Tang Zhanyue said "ha" with utmost sarcasm: "You mean, all you need to do is apologize for attempted murder? Has Attorney Wei's interstellar law gone to his belly?"
Next to them, Su Miao and Xu Feng frowned in disapproval and spoke nonsense in front of them. Wei Jinyan didn't take the Supervisory Star Office seriously either.
Wei Jinyan sighed, "Don't misunderstand me. Moreover, there was no clear evidence that they attempted murder at the time. At most, it was a mistake. He Lanyi lacked common sense."
Tang Zhanyue sneered: "You have found a loophole. Do you think you are very powerful when you successfully defended a murderer? Do you still know the words fairness and justice?"
"Zhanyue." Wei Jinyan looked at her helplessly.
He didn't understand why Tang Zhanyue insisted on clinging to this matter. Obviously nothing happened to her, but she had a second awakening because of it, right?
"Forget it, there's nothing to say to a moron with no moral sense." Tang Zhanyue turned and left.
Wei Jinyan's disappointed voice came from behind, "When did you become so unreasonable?"
Tang Zhanyue's expression darkened, and the wind around him stopped.
Su Miao's heart skipped a beat, "Calm down!"
Although they followed her in the name of protection, only they knew the actual mission. And this is a ruthless man who kills an S-class killer alone. If he really goes crazy, she can't stop him!
Xu Feng next to him was also tense, ready to save Wei Jinyan's life at any time.
At this moment, an orange-red shadow suddenly shot out and hit Wei Jinyan in the stomach.
Wei Jinyan grunted, flew out with his feet off the ground, hit the floating car with a "clang", and then fell to his knees in embarrassment.
The stagnant atmosphere was broken, Tang Zhanyue lowered his head and looked surprised, "Chili?"
Chili ran up to her happily on her short legs, raised her head and said "chirp~" at her, her tail almost wagging behind her.
Tang Zhanyue's thunderstorm cleared up in an instant. She smiled and picked up Chili, and nuzzled her face skillfully, "Oh, our Chili is so considerate, she even knows how to help me vent my anger."
Ye Zheng then walked over, stood in front of Tang Zhanyue, and said with a smile: "You can't see the good in Zhanyue because you are blind and blind. If you have time to mess around here, why not go to the hospital and get an ophthalmology appointment."
Wei Jinyan coughed twice and got up from the ground with anger in his heart. However, when he looked up and saw the tall figure, he was instantly stunned.Misfire in between.
How could it be Ye Zheng? He looked behind the man in a daze. Tang Zhanyue was holding the familiar orange puppy affectionately. That was... Ye Zheng's spiritual body? !
